name: Royal Exchange Plc
source: CRON 20261014: Royal Exchange Plc consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the period ended 30 June 2026, Group column (NGX doclib filing library), thousands of naira scaled to naira. Interest income plus fee and commission plus investment income plus share of profit on investment in associate plus other operating income equals the printed operating income exactly, and that less the printed administrative expenses equals the printed profit before tax. The filing charged no income tax, so profit for the period equals profit before tax and no tax cell is written. EPS in naira per share from the printed kobo figure. | Royal Exchange Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, Group Five Year Financial Summary pages 90 and 91, printed in thousands of naira; values stored below as absolute naira. The top line is the printed Net income figure for the insurance group. Rows the summary does not print are left absent. | CRON 20261005: added Operating Expenses and Operating Profit (EBIT) from the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 36 of the FY2025 annual report (Group column, thousands of naira stored as absolute naira): operating income 1,660,808 less impairment charge 154,594 less personnel expenses 221,079 less operating expenses 417,681 equals 867,454 profit before tax, and FY2024 is 1,575,142 less a 38,687 write-back less 179,077 less 405,714 equals 1,029,038.
